# J.R. Martinez Roofing & Remodeling

> Roofing & remodeling based in San Antonio, Texas. Jose Martinez and his crew replace and repair shingle, tile and metal roofs across West San Antonio, and he stays on site from tear-off to clean-up.

- Phone: (210) 427-6418
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Leon Valley, Balcones Heights, Helotes, Castroville, Somerset
- Google rating: 4.8 from 29 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/jr-martinez-roofing/quote.html

## Services
- Roof replacement: Shingle, tile and metal roofs replaced by a crew that cleans up after itself.
- Standing-seam metal roofs: Metal roofs in charcoal, brown, blue and more, for homes in town and out in Castroville.
- Leak repair & emergencies: Leaks tracked down and fixed fast, including ones other roofers missed.
- Commercial roofs & coatings: Metal roof cleaning and coating, skylight removal and repairs for local businesses.
- Chimneys, siding & trim: Chimney caps and repairs, new siding, gable vents and exterior trim.
- Remodeling & builds: Pergolas, additions, sheds, drywall, cement and bathroom remodels.

## About
J.R. Martinez Roofing & Remodeling is based on Bradford Avenue in West San Antonio. Owner Jose Martinez works on the job site with his crew from start to finish, and Spanish is spoken. Jose's customers include homeowners across the west side and businesses that have used him for years, for metal roof coatings, emergency repairs and even a bathroom remodel. Reviewers say he is punctual and quick, explains the work in detail, and cleans up well when the job is done.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Is the roof estimate free?
  A: Yes. Reviewers mention getting a free estimate, and you can request one online or by phone.
- Q: Can you find a leak another roofer missed?
  A: That is a common call. One customer's five-year-old roof kept leaking after another company's work, and Jose found and fixed the leak within hours.
- Q: Do you install standing-seam metal roofs outside San Antonio?
  A: Yes. Recent work includes a standing-seam metal roof in Castroville, plus jobs across Leon Valley, Helotes and Somerset.
- Q: Do you work on commercial roofs?
  A: Yes. Local businesses use J.R. Martinez for metal roof cleaning and coating, skylight removal and emergency repairs.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. Jose and the crew speak Spanish, so you can talk through your roof in the language you prefer.
- Q: Do you do more than roofs?
  A: Yes. Siding, painting, drywall, cement, pergolas, additions and bathroom remodels.
